subject: On-prem deployment code-gate & evidence request
messages:
From: Jamie Park <jamie.park@acme.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, security-acct@acme.com
Date: 2026-10-17T15:23:00Z
Subject: Evidence and gating items for on-prem delivery

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. The Acme security team needs a short evidence bundle so we can close the on-prem environment readiness checklist. Specifically they asked for:
- Signed/verified Helm chart digests for the private charts we deploy to customer cluster (chart digests + provenance).
- Terraform state excerpts showing module version pins and backend locking events for the last three runs.
- CI job run IDs and logs for the pipelines that produce signed artifacts (GitLab job names would be helpful).
- Small manifest describing how Ansible playbooks are versioned and where checksums live.

Can you put together a minimal "evidence pack" (tar of small text artifacts or secure link) by Monday EOD? If you prefer, we can accept a secure S3 URL or a DocuSign envelope for signed attestations.

Jamie
Security Program Manager
Acme Financial

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-17T16:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Evidence and gating items for on-prem delivery

Hi team —

FYI: Acme asked for a concise evidence pack to close the readiness gate. I can assemble a first pass but will need artifacts from TF and CI. Quick plan:

Action owners:
- Laura: extract the relevant tfstate snippets + module version pins, note backend locking events (last 3 runs).
- Markus: generate the list of Helm chart SHAs / provenance we sign during release pipeline.
- Kimberly: capture the CI job run IDs and a log excerpt for the signing pipeline (gitlab-ci: release/sign-artifacts).
- Vivek: short note on Ansible playbook versioning and where we store checksums (ansible-galaxy meta or artifact store).

Target: assemble in s3://redwood-evidence/acme/2026-10-17/ with a top-level evidence_manifest_v1.yaml and share a read-only link to Jamie by Monday 10/19 EOD PST. If we can't produce everything, we'll document the gap and proposed mitigation.

If anyone can't meet these owners, call it out now.

Thanks — Marissa
Senior Manager, Customer Deployments
Redwood Inference
